title: Coole Lodge, 9 Barnstead Drive, Ballintemple, Co. Cork, T12C7W4
seoTitle: Coole Lodge, 9 Barnstead Drive, Ballintemple, Co. Cork, T12C7W4
description:
Coole Lodge, 9 Barnstead Drive, presents a rare opportunity to purchase a 4 bedroom detached property with a   substantial private garden to the rear. It is located in a highly sought after, mature and private cul-de-sac, just off the Blackrock Road. 

The Barnstead Drive Estate was constructed in the 1960s by O’Connor Builders and designed by architect Denis Higgins. The property has been extended to the front with a large front facing sitting room filled with natural light. 

This home benefits from its’ extensive site size with a large, open graveled driveway providing space for up to 4    vehicles. The driveway is wonderfully bordered by mature hedging on both sides with two large stone pillars framing the entrance onto the property’s grounds.

One of the standout features of this fantastic property is the expansive, South East facing back garden which extends to approx. 0.25 of an acre. The back garden also encloses an outdoor swimming pool.
The interior of the property is tastefully decorated with warm wood tones from the hardwood kitchen and flooring, with a neutral colour scheme sweeping through the residence.

Coole Lodge is excellently positioned with numerous amenities such as St Michael’s Tennis Club, Marina Park,   Dundanion Medical Centre and Blackrock Hurling Club being within walking distance of the property.

The overall setting offers privacy matched with an abundance of space and tranquility neatly placed in the heart of Blackrock.

Entrance 		 
The front door opens onto a well lit L-shaped lobby, benefiting from recessed lighting, large double glazed windows and natural timber floors. There is a cloakroom and bathroom just off  the foyer entrance. Recessed lighting.

Bathroom 	 			
Partially tiled accessibility bathroom with 3-piece suite and Marble tiled floors. Recessed lighting. 


Family Room 	 			
A bright and elegant family room recently added on as part of an extension. The room is well lit by a  combination of PVC double French doors, and PVC double glazed windows. The rooms white walls are compliment by the warm hues of the timber floor and doors. Recessed lighting. 

Utility/Laundry Room 			
Tiled floor, eye and floor level cabinets, plumbed  and wired for washer and dryer, with extensive storage. Recessed lighting. 

Kitchen/Dining 
Bright and beautifully presented dual L-shaped   kitchen with quality slate countertop, tiled floor.  
The kitchen natural flows into a well lit dining space with natural timber floor, where diners benefit from a patio door opening onto the property’s extensive rear garden. Recessed lighting with underfloor heating.

Living Room 
Connected to the dining room, the main living room  centers around a modern wood burning stove and gets natural light from a large scenic window,  providing an excellent view of the whole garden.   Recessed lighting. 

Sitting Room 
Bright and cosy room, accessible via the lobby, natural timber floor, double French doors  to rear garden. Recessed lighting 

Main Bedroom 	      
This bright and spacious principal bedroom, with carpet floor, floor to ceiling wardrobes.

Ensuite 
WC, wash hand basin, shower, tiled walls, and anti-slip flooring.

Bedroom 2 	         
Large double glazed window, carpet flooring.

Ensuite 
WC, and wash hand basin. Tiled floor.

Bathroom 
Fully tiled bathroom, with 3 piece suite, anti-slip floors and electric shower.

Bedroom 3
Bright and airy room  with carpet floor and PVC double glazed window.

Bedroom 4 
Bright and airy room with carpet floor and PVC double glazed window.

Ensuite 
WC, wash hand basin, shower. 

Attic
Floored attic with recessed storage. Accessed via pull down attic ladder. 

Front Garden 
There is a generous paved driveway that offers    ample off street parking, the drive is neatly bordered by mature hedging.

Rear Garden
This beautifully maintained garden offers a private, sun-drenched escape with a spacious natural stone patio perfect for outdoor dining. 

Tucked at the far end is a swimming pool
